CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 IN (0, 6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END
CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 10 THEN 'Early October'... END
